title: Fake trading app: third, larger 'top-up' after a fake profit
story: Added to a WhatsApp 'stock tips' group, he invested ₹10,000 and then ₹18,000 through a fake app, received ₹2,400 'profit' to build trust, and is now told to deposit ₹32,000 to unlock an IPO allotment.
why: A rising series of payments to new accounts, a small credit from a stranger, and now 44× his usual payment to a mule-network account. No call, but journey and payee should agree on their own.
